avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces oxcarbazepine levels; may decrease seizure control
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel on alternatives for mood support

avoid_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May lower seizure threshold and reduce drug efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Counsel patient to discontinue or switch to non-herbal alternatives

caution_supplements.name: Calcium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May reduce oxcarbazepine absorption if taken simultaneously
caution_supplements.action: Separate dosing by 2+ hours; monitor seizure control

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential for additive CNS depression and reduced absorption
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased dizziness/fatigue; separate dosing if needed

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may modestly increase oxcarbazepine levels
caution_foods.action: Limit consumption; monitor for toxicity signs (ataxia, diplopia, hyponatremia)

monitoring_notes: Monitor serum sodium levels periodically as hyponatremia is a known adverse effect; assess seizure frequency and CNS symptoms when interactions are suspected. Coordinate with neurology on any supplement changes.
